name: Apple Shared Album
description: Show still images from a public Apple Shared Album as a Kiosk Satellite screensaver.
author: dark-matter-design

settings.title: Public album link
settings.description: Paste a public icloud.com/sharedalbum/#… or photos.icloud.com/shared/album/… link. SDK 1 stores and displays this as an ordinary string setting. Invitation, approval, and sign-in links are not supported.

settings.title: Time per photo
settings.description: How long each still image remains visible, from 5 seconds to 1 hour. Existing saved values remain unchanged.

settings.title: Photo order
settings.description: Shuffle each pass or preserve Apple's album order in either direction.

settings.title: Photo layout
settings.description: Fit keeps the full image on black; fill crops edges to cover the display.

settings.title: Show clock
settings.description: Show the device's current local time over each photo. Off by default.

settings.title: Overlay position
settings.description: Place the clock and any enabled photo metadata together in one corner.

settings.title: 24-hour clock
settings.description: Show current time in 24-hour format instead of AM/PM.

settings.title: Show seconds
settings.description: Include seconds in the current-time clock.

settings.title: Show current date
settings.description: Show today's device-local date below the clock. This is not the photo capture date.

settings.title: Show photo capture date
settings.description: Show the photo's capture date when Apple metadata or local image EXIF contains one.

settings.title: Show photo location
settings.description: Show a bounded place name only from explicit local IPTC/XMP location fields, otherwise source-labeled GPS coordinates from local EXIF. Captions are never treated as locations. No geocoding or third-party request is made. Off by default for privacy.

settings.title: Shift overlay pixels
settings.description: Move the complete text overlay by up to 10 pixels once per minute to reduce OLED burn-in. The photo does not move. Off by default, matching Kiosk Satellite's Pixel shift default.

settings.title: Overlay color
settings.description: Text color for the clock, current date, and photo metadata.

settings.title: Overlay size
settings.description: Scale overlay text from 50 to 150 percent.

settings.title: Font family
settings.description: Use a WebView-safe generic font family; host-bundled Clock fonts are not exposed through SDK 1.

settings.title: Font weight
settings.description: Choose how heavy the overlay text is drawn.
